# 服务100多个品牌总结出的SEO方法清单

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-01-30 23:56（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2017265560258498600
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

我为 100+ 个品牌做过 SEO。

其中 95% 都获得了流量增长。

你也可以这样做：

- 别再追逐关键词，去覆盖主题。Google 奖励的是深度，而不是重复。

- 你的主页应该链接到最重要的页面。就是这样。多数创始人会忘记这一点。

- 内链是免费的，用起来。采用不同的锚文本，把内容连接成一张网。

- 页面速度比你想的更重要。网站每慢一天，排名就会持续流失。

- 写作首先面向人，其次才是机器人。但一定要让机器人看懂你写了什么。

- 一个支柱页面，多篇集群文章。这种结构屡试不爽。

- SEO 标题不是创意写作练习。表达清楚，包含关键词，然后继续做下一件事。

- 持续性胜过爆发力。连续 12 个月每月发布 4 篇，胜过一个月发布 48 篇。

- 竞争对手的外链就是你的路线图。研究它们，再去争取相同的外链。

- Schema 标记被低估了。花 10 分钟设置，就可能获得富媒体摘要。

- 别把精力分散在 50 个主题上。先拿下少数几个，再扩展。

- 主题权威确实存在。Google 知道你是真的专家，还是在瞎猜。

- 文章底部的 FAQ 依然有效。简单、有效，做起来。

- 写新内容之前，先更新旧内容。投入小，回报高。

- 网站结构应该让一个 10 岁的孩子都能理解。如果连你都觉得混乱，Google 也会困惑。

- 来自细分领域相关网站的外链，始终胜过来自不相干的高 DA 网站的外链。

- 社交流量代表用户参与，Google 会注意到。把内容分享出去。

- 图片的 alt 文本是免费的展示空间，利用好它。

- 长内容在真正有用时才会赢。
为了长度而堆字，只是在制造噪声。

- 每周追踪排名。被衡量的东西，才能得到改善。

- 客座文章仍然有效，只是要挑选发布渠道，并确保与自己的领域相关。

- 如果你有实体经营地点，就别忽视本地 SEO。46% 的 Google 搜索都带有本地意图。

- 在前 100 词里回答问题，然后再展开。Google 很喜欢把这种内容用于精选摘要。

- 失效链接建设很繁琐，但有效。找到死链，提供你的内容作为替代。

- URL 结构很重要。保持清晰、简短，并与关键词相关。

- 别做 100 个平庸页面，做 20 个优秀页面。

- 在文章中嵌入 YouTube 视频。这能提高页面停留时间，Google 会关注这一点。

- AI 搜索正在快速到来。争取在多个来源中获得提及，共识就是新的排名因素。

- SEO 会产生复利。今天做的工作，未来多年都会带来回报。保持耐心。

- 别再只看 SEO 建议，开始执行。行动胜过理论。

如果你想看更多这样的帖子串，关注我 [@fba](https://x.com/fba)。我分享的都是真正有效的做法。

## 英文原文

I've worked the SEO of 100+ brands.

95% of them have gotten positive traffic growth.

Here's how you can get the same:

- Stop chasing keywords. Chase topics. Google -rewards depth, not repetition.

- Your homepage should link to your most important pages. Period. Most founders forget this.

- Internal links are free. Use them. Varied anchor text. Connect your content like a web.

- Page speed matters more than you think. A slow site bleeds rankings every single day.

- Write for humans first, bots second. But make sure the bots understand what you wrote.

- One pillar page. Multiple cluster posts. This structure wins every time.

- Meta titles aren't creative writing exercises. Be clear. Include your keyword. Move on.

- Consistency beats intensity. 4 posts a month for 12 months beats 48 posts in one month.

- Your competitors' backlinks are your roadmap. Study them. Then go get the same ones.

- Schema markup is underrated. It takes 10 minutes and can land you rich snippets.

- Don't spread yourself thin across 50 topics. Own a few ones. Then expand.

- Topical authority is real. Google knows when you're an expert vs. when you're guessing.

- FAQs at the bottom of posts still work. Simple. Effective. Do it.

- Update old content before writing new content. Low effort, high reward.

- Your site structure should make sense to a 10-year-old. If it confuses you, it confuses Google.

- Backlinks from niche-relevant sites beat backlinks from high-DA random sites. Every time.

- Social traffic signals engagement. Google notices. Share your content.

- Alt text on images is free real estate. Use it.

- Long-form content wins when it's actually useful. 
Length for length's sake is just noise.

- Track your rankings weekly. What gets measured gets improved.

- Guest posting still works. Just be picky about where you publish. Should be relevant to your niche.

- Don't ignore local SEO if you have a physical location. 46% of all Google searches have local intent.

- Answer the question in the first 100 words. Then elaborate. Google loves this for featured snippets.

- Broken link building is tedious but effective. Find dead links. Offer your content as a replacement.

- Your URL structure matters. Keep it clean, short, and keyword-relevant.

- Don't build 100 mediocre pages. Build 20 excellent ones.

- Embed YouTube videos on your posts. It increases time on page. Google watches that.

- AI search is coming fast. Get mentioned across multiple sources. Consensus is the new ranking factor.

- SEO compounds. The work you do today pays dividends for years. Stay patient.

- Stop reading SEO advice. Start implementing it. Action beats theory.

If you want more threads like this, follow me [@fba](https://x.com/fba). I share what actually works.
